mainRule: The agent should only have one feature in in_progress at any time

status_legend.in_progress: The feature is the current active task.
status_legend.blocked: Work cannot continue until a documented blocker is resolved.

features.title: Add --severity CRITICAL to trivy fs alongside the existing stream filter
features.user_visible_behavior: Trivy pre-filters to CRITICAL before the report ever reaches the app, so the report written to disk is smaller and cheaper to stream-parse. The stream parser still filters, counts and caps independently, so neither layer is a single point of trust for what reaches Redis.
evidence: npm run test -> 12 suites / 127 tests passed, 2026-08-31
npx eslint on both changed files -> No issues found (exit 0), 2026-08-31
features.notes: Implements the third trade-off documented in README 'Trade-offs and design notes'. The Severity !== 'CRITICAL' check in trivy-stream-parser.service.ts is deliberately retained: it is boundary validation against an external process, not a redundant internal invariant.
